subject: SILENT WRONG: a SLICE as the operand of a modifying scalar operator does nothing -- `@h{@keys}++`, `@h{LIST} += N` and `undef @h{LIST}` create no key (perl vivifies every key of the slice and acts on the LAST one), `@a[0,2]++` leaves @a alone; the emission is `(p-post++ (p-hslice %h @k))` / `(p-undef (p-hslice ...))`, a modify of the rvalue slice (Rosetta 0243, 0808)
